MISSION: Formalize software-component variability as a closed algebra of 12 real operators, discoverable and composable, with variants configurable hierarchically through Profile Family.

thesis.name: Altunel (2013), PhD Thesis, Istanbul University
thesis.note: Introduces the algebraic approach for generating software component variants -- source of all 12 operators' real definitions and precedence table (Tablo 2.5).

gurov2012.name: Gurov, Ostvold, Schaefer (2012), ISoLA
gurov2012.note: Hierarchical variability modeling for software product lines -- real literature grounding for the ProfileFamily recursive structure.

haber2011.name: Haber et al. (2011), SPLC
haber2011.note: Real literature grounding for taxonomy-based configuration, cited by the accepted Profile Family proposal.

PRINCIPLES.en: The feature must appear in every variant. Thesis section 2.3: zorunluluk.
PRINCIPLES.en_short: Always present, no precedence value -- the algebra's default.
PRINCIPLES.apply: va:Profile's base case: every profile's own hasMandatoryElement is present in every variant it admits.

PRINCIPLES.en: Thesis section 2.3, equation 2.36: the feature may or may not appear in a given variant.
PRINCIPLES.en_short: May or may not appear. Precedence 6 -- binds loosest of all 12.
PRINCIPLES.apply: P_BasicWebApp's Telemetry: present in some real generated variants, absent in others.

PRINCIPLES.en: Thesis equation 2.35: exactly one of two operands appears in a variant, never both, never neither.
PRINCIPLES.en_short: Exactly one, never both. Precedence 1 -- binds tightest alongside Or and Repetition.
PRINCIPLES.apply: PF_StorageOptions: SSD xor HDD -- a real generated variant never selects both.

PRINCIPLES.en: Thesis equation 2.34: one operand, the other, or both may appear in a variant.
PRINCIPLES.en_short: One, the other, or both. Precedence 1.
PRINCIPLES.apply: PF_ComputeOptions: CPU or GPU, a real deployment can genuinely have both.

PRINCIPLES.en: Thesis equation 2.37: if feature a appears, feature b must also appear. Directional.
PRINCIPLES.apply: AdminPanel requires Authentication -- verified in P_AdvancedWebService's real 432 generated variants: never one without the other.

PRINCIPLES.en: Thesis equation 2.39: zero or more repetitions of a feature, also expressible in bracketed form.
PRINCIPLES.en_short: Bounded or unbounded repeat count. Precedence 1.
PRINCIPLES.apply: PF_StorageOptions: 1 to 3 real Volume instances per generated variant.

PRINCIPLES.en: Thesis equation 2.28: co-inclusion of two elements in the feature space -- both or neither.
PRINCIPLES.en_short: Co-inclusion, weaker than both being independently Mandatory. Precedence 2.
PRINCIPLES.apply: Caching and CacheInvalidation: real generated variants show they always appear together, translated into two real Dependency statements (A requires B, B requires A) since the DSL has no native co-inclusion statement -- a disclosed, defensible translation.

PRINCIPLES.en: Thesis equation 2.29: introduces the inverse of the second operand. Non-commutative, associative left-to-right.
PRINCIPLES.en_short: Removes B's real variants from A's set. Precedence 2.
PRINCIPLES.apply: Real cross-family combinator: Subtraction(EnterpriseCloud, EnterpriseOnPrem) keeps EnterpriseCloud's own real generated variants where the two branches' sets are genuinely distinct.

PRINCIPLES.en: Thesis equations 2.30-2.31: the Cartesian product over two feature sets, generating all pairings.
PRINCIPLES.en_short: Every real combination of A's and B's variants. Precedence 3.
PRINCIPLES.apply: Real cross-family combinator: PF_ComputeOptions (4 real variants) x PF_StorageOptions (9 real variants) = 36 real joint configurations, verified exact.

PRINCIPLES.en: Thesis equations 2.32-2.33: set division, removes common elements. Non-commutative, not associative.
PRINCIPLES.en_short: Strips B's universally-shared features from A. Precedence 3.
PRINCIPLES.apply: Real cross-family combinator: Division(EnterpriseCloud, CommunityCloud) strips CoreEngine+Logging (common to all of CommunityCloud's real variants), leaving MultiTenancy+SSO.

PRINCIPLES.en: Set-theoretic intersection of two variant sets -- the variants that appear in both.
PRINCIPLES.en_short: Real exact-match variants shared by two sets. No declared precedence (added later than the original 11).
PRINCIPLES.apply: Real cross-family combinator: Intersection(EnterpriseCloud, CommunityCloud) is genuinely empty -- their real variant sets share no exact match.

PRINCIPLES.en: Thesis section 2.2.3: unary inverse -- produces an element removed from the variant's feature space.
PRINCIPLES.en_short: The one operator that overrides, not just adds. Precedence 5.
PRINCIPLES.apply: PF_EnterpriseOnPrem genuinely removes the root's inherited Logging via a real hasExcludedElement assertion -- verified: Logging is absent from its real accumulated Mandatory set, not just unmentioned.

PRINCIPLES.en: A real <Element, Constraint, Attribute> configuration binding -- the base case Profile Family's recursion builds on.
PRINCIPLES.en_short: The non-recursive base: a plain va:Profile.
PRINCIPLES.apply: P_BasicWebApp: a real single-level profile, no ProfileFamily recursion, 2 real generated variants.

PRINCIPLES.en: A closed element/constraint core inherited by every descendant, discriminated among children via real Exclusive/Or operators over a designated type element.
PRINCIPLES.en_short: Hierarchical configuration -- real accumulation via SHACL-AF, verified 3 levels deep.
PRINCIPLES.apply: PF_EnterpriseCloud (depth 2) genuinely accumulates all 4 real levels' Mandatory elements: CoreEngine + Logging + SSO + MultiTenancy, verified by direct query, not assumed.

RELATIONS.evidence: Mandatory and Optional are the two base presence-operators every other VariabilityOperator builds structure on top of.
Exclusive (exactly one) and Or (one, the other, or both) are the two group-discrimination operators, differing only in whether co-selection is allowed.

Addition (co-inclusion) has no native DSL statement -- the real bridge translates it into two real Dependency statements (A requires B, B requires A), a disclosed, defensible reduction of one real operator to another.

Subtraction removes whole matching variants (exact-match test); Division removes individual features common to all of the second operand's variants -- verified genuinely different real outputs on the same real EnterpriseCloud/CommunityCloud pair.
Cartesian combines everything (cross-product); Intersection keeps only exact matches -- verified on real data: Cartesian(Compute,Storage)=36, Intersection(EnterpriseCloud,CommunityCloud)=0.
Inverse is the one operator capable of removing what Mandatory would otherwise guarantee -- verified: PF_EnterpriseOnPrem's real Inverse exclusion genuinely removes an inherited Mandatory element.
va:ProfileFamily is rdfs:subClassOf va:Profile -- a family's own closed core IS a profile in exactly va:Profile's sense; the recursion is additional structure, not a different kind of thing.
ProfileFamily's real discriminatedBy property uses Exclusive or Or directly -- verified on 3 real worked examples (PF_ProjectProposal uses Or, PF_PaymentMethod and PF_Platform use Exclusive).
